units: <cite ref="Yevamot 87b:20">Yeb. 87ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ש׳ כהודאה דמיא</he> silence is tantamount to admission.
<cite ref="Zevachim 115b:14">Zeb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>פעמים … על הש׳ וכ׳</he> at times one keeps silence and is rewarded for his silence, at times one speaks &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 99a:1">Pes. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>יפה ש׳ לחכמים וכ׳</he> silence becometh the wise, how much more the stupid; Treat. Der. Er. Zuṭṭa ch. VII.
<cite ref="Sotah 39a:2">Sot. 39ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Nehemiah 8:5">Neh. VIII, 5</cite>) <he>אין עמידה אלא ש׳</he> standing means being silent; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:3:5">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:12">Tosef. ib. II, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 20b:3">Bets. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מה זו ש׳</he> what does silence mean? (i.e. better be silent).
